sents.zh: 清朝有一位很有名的大王，叫康熙。
sents.en: The Qing dynasty had a famous ruler called Kangxi.

sents.zh: 他很小的时候就做了王。
sents.en: He became ruler when he was very young.
He ruled for more than sixty years.

sents.zh: 他每天很早就起来做事。
sents.en: He got up very early every day to work.
He also loved learning new things.

sents.zh: 他学数，也学西边来的学问。
sents.en: He studied numbers, and learning that came from the west.

sents.zh: 西边来的人给他讲天上的事。
sents.en: People from the west told him about the sky.

sents.zh: 他让人做了中国的大地图。
sents.en: He had a great map of China made.
At that time China was very large.

sents.zh: 很多人说，他是最好的王之一。
sents.en: Many people say he was one of the best rulers.
